actualMessage: Start the onboarding conversation now. Send your first onboarding message. The user's locale is "en-US". Respond in the user's language, not in English just because this prompt is in English.

args.content: Click the due date to change it
Click me to learn how to hide checked items
Click me to see even more detail
See finished items in the “Done” view
Click me to learn how to see your content your way
Click the blue New button to add a task
Check the box to mark items as done
From the list, click the ‣ button to change your filters.
Then check “To Do” and “In Progress” to only see unchecked items in the list. Click “Save for everyone” to finish.
Every item in your to do database table has a page that you can edit with content blocks (things like text, bullets, images etc.) - it’s just like editing any other document.
Type the / key to add all kinds of content — headers, pages, etc.
Hover over this line, click and hold the : then drag to move it around
A “view” is a way to look at your data. It can be simple as preset filters to a full calendar of events — all using the same underlying data.
Click Done view to see just your finished tasks.
Your content can be shown in countless ways within Notion. Try adding a new view to the To Do List database to render your content how you want.
Hover over the “Todo” and “Done” view tabs and click the ‣ to select a new view
Select Board (or whatever view you’d prefer to select!). This adds a new view and can always be undone.
Now see your tasks in a board view! Try drag and dropping tasks into done to mark them as completed.
You can keep track of all sorts of other information about your to dos!
Click “➕ Add a property” to see all the other things you can do.
This Database is configured as a Tasks database which allows its contents to appear on your Home tab. All tasks will make their way there.

annotation.title: Give your to-dos a Home with Task databases
annotation.description: Easily manage all your tasks from Home with Notion Task databases.

name: Todo List
description: Stay organized with tasks, your way.

args.content: Download the desktop app to unlock offline mode and take Notion with you wherever you go
Start building with Notion Agent ‣. Tell it what you’re here to do, and Agent will create it for you in seconds.
Click anywhere below and type / to see what you can create – headers, tables, to-do’s, etc.
Find, organize, and add new pages using the sidebar to the left 👈
This is a toggle block. Click the little triangle to see a few more useful tips!
Type /page to add a new page and nest anything, anywhere
Check out the To Do List we added for you with more tips and tricks to best use Notion
Make a new page and type /meet to capture meeting notes and thoughts effortlessly
Click ‣ Marketplace in your sidebar to try setups from our incredible community
Check out Notion Academy to level up your Notion knowledge through guided courses (and earn badges while you’re at it!)
Looking for a little more guidance?
Chat with one of our experts who will help answer your questions live. You’ll leave with a working setup and clarity on how to keep building.
Afterwards, find all your meetings in one place in the Meetings tab
